hook.title:
Set this up in
under 20 seconds
hook.subtitle: A birthday countdown that repeats forever 👇

scenes.voice: Bet you can set this up in under twenty seconds.

scenes.caption: New ticket → Birthday
scenes.voice: Tap New ticket, then pick Birthday.

scenes.caption: Name + birthday date
scenes.voice: Add whose birthday it is and the date. Repeats every year is already on.

scenes.caption: Save it
scenes.voice: Save it. It counts down to the next one.

scenes.caption: Bonus: it rolls over to next year
scenes.voice: Bonus: after the day, it counts to next year on its own.
